RORK — GITHUB TOKEN BINDING AUDIT

Do NOT ask me to provide or recreate my GitHub token.
Do NOT print or expose the token value.

Find the GitHub credential already stored in this project/runtime and report exactly where it is bound.

Check, in order:
1. Project environment variables / secrets
2. Runtime environment variables
3. Deployment environment variables
4. GitHub integration / connection settings
5. Any secret store used by this Rork project

Look specifically for:
- GITHUB_TOKEN
- GH_TOKEN
- GITHUB_PAT
- GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
- any equivalent GitHub credential variable

Then test whether the active runtime can actually use the credential against:
ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

Return ONLY this certificate:

GITHUB TOKEN LOCATION: <exact variable/secret location>
VARIABLE NAME: <name>
BOUND TO ACTIVE RUNTIME: PASS / FAIL
GITHUB AUTH TEST: PASS / FAIL
REPOSITORY READ ACCESS: PASS / FAIL
REPOSITORY WRITE ACCESS: PASS / FAIL
ACTIONS ACCESS: PASS / FAIL
HTTP ERROR: <exact 401/403/error if any>
TOKEN VALUE: REDACTED

If no token is found, state:
GITHUB TOKEN LOCATION: NOT FOUND

Do not tell me to create a new token unless a real auth test proves the existing credential is missing, expired, revoked, or returns 401/403.
